final: WITH purpose_averages AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM "order" WHERE amount > 2802 GROUP BY k_symbol), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM purpose_averages) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS amount_above_overall FROM purpose_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg
